# Felix Keuya Renewable Energy and Project Finance Analyst

Felix Keuya provides fixed-scope and white-label analyst support to renewable energy developers, investors, lenders, advisory firms, EPCs and energy platforms across Africa and emerging markets.

## Core services
- Renewable project opportunity screening
- Lender-grade financial model review and sensitivity analysis
- Investment committee memos, lender packs and project valuation
- Corporate PPA, electricity wheeling and commercial analysis
- Grid-connection, curtailment and contract-risk analysis
- African power-market and project-development diligence
- Embedded white-label analyst support

## Public financial model library
The following synthetic Excel models can be inspected online and downloaded. They do not contain confidential client information.
- Solar IPP project-finance model: https://felix-keuya-portfolio.vercel.app/models/public-solar-ipp-model.html
- South Africa corporate PPA and wheeling model: https://felix-keuya-portfolio.vercel.app/models/sa-corporate-ppa-wheeling-model.html
